nasa_id: NHQ_201_0163_VF_FIRST ALL-WOMAN SPACEWALK REPLACES FAULTY ELECTRICAL BOX ON SPACE STATION
title: First All-Woman Spacewalk Replaces Faulty Electrical Box on Space Station (NASA VideoFile)
contents: Real ISS external-camera b-roll of NASA astronauts Christina Koch and Jessica Meir on the first all-woman spacewalk (18 Oct 2019): suited astronauts on the truss, solar arrays, and Earth below. Natural sound only (quiet). Skips the opening text slate.
